title: Controllers: PlayStation (wired) + Xbox (wireless) - which controller the game hears (watch only)
intro: Both controllers connected (PS5 wired, Xbox wireless), co-op OFF, playing the Arisen, standing somewhere open and safe (no enemies). This only records; it changes nothing. Press End (keyboard) when ready.

steps.text: Get ready: put both controllers in reach. Press End to start.
PS5 ONLY: hold its left stick forward. Xbox untouched.
XBOX ONLY: hold its left stick to the RIGHT. PS5 untouched.
BOTH: PS5 stick forward AND Xbox stick to the RIGHT at the same time.
XBOX ONLY: press A a few times (jump).
PS5 ONLY: press Cross a few times (jump).
Done. Tell Claude what the Arisen did in each step.

probes.pads:
local o = {}
local function ax(v) if not v then return "-" end local ok, s = pcall(function() return string.format("%.2f,%.2f", v.x, v.y) end) return ok and s or "?" end
pcall(function() o[#o + 1] = "mode=" .. tostring(sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.UserInputManager"):call("get_HIDInputMode")) end)
pcall(function()
  local inp = sdk.get_managed_singleton("app.CharacterManager"):call("get_ManualPlayer"):call("get_Input")
  o[#o + 1] = "arisenL=" .. ax(inp:call("get_AxisL"))
end)
pcall(function()
  local gp = sdk.get_native_singleton("via.hid.GamePad"); local td = sdk.find_type_definition("via.hid.GamePad")
  local m = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_MergedDevice")
  if m then o[#o + 1] = string.format("merged b=%X L=%s", m:call("get_Button") or 0, ax(m:call("get_AxisL"))) end
  local li = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_LastInputDevice")
  if li then o[#o + 1] = string.format("last=%X", li:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF) end
  local ok, uid = pcall(sdk.call_native_func, gp, td, "get_LastInputDeviceUniqueId")
  if ok then o[#o + 1] = "lastuid=" .. tostring(uid) end
  local arr = sdk.call_native_func(gp, td, "get_ConnectingDevices")
  local n = arr:call("get_Count")
  o[#o + 1] = "n=" .. tostring(n)
  for i = 0, n - 1 do
    local dv = arr:call("get_Item", i)
    local tn = "?"
    pcall(function() tn = dv:get_type_definition():get_full_name() end)
    o[#o + 1] = string.format("d%d[%X %s] b=%X L=%s raw=%s", i, dv:get_address() & 0xFFFFFF, tn, dv:call("get_Button") or 0, ax(dv:call("get_AxisL")), ax(dv:call("get_RawAxisL")))
  end
end)
return table.concat(o, " ")
